subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: post-call recap & numbers

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a check on the sizing numbers so we can put together a scoped hosted-API quote: 

Key call takeaways (from our notes):
- Primary use: customer-facing chat assistant + follow-on summarization.
- Typical prompt+response payload: ~150 tokens (avg per request).
- Expected monthly token volume: ~320,000,000 tokens (please confirm if we should budget 300–350M).
- Expected peak TPS: ~28 TPS (short bursts up to ~30 TPS), steady-state 6–10 TPS.
- Budget range (initial pilot): $12,000–$18,000 / month; potential for a 12mo committed discount if we move to production.
- Target unit economics you mentioned: roughly $30–$40 / 1M tokens (we'll validate with pricing scenarios).

Next steps I propose:
1) Can you confirm the monthly token range (300–350M) and peak TPS (30)?
2) I'll generate a scoped hosted-API estimate (attachment) and a few committed/overage scenarios (monthly & 12mo commit) for review.
3) Schedule a 30-min technical deep dive with Rishi to go over latency SLOs, streaming, and batching considerations.

I've attached a working estimate and a short pricing tiers summary for reference. If those numbers look right, we'll push a formal quote into HubSpot and loop in procurement/legal.

Attachments: redwood_hosted_pricing_estimate_q2_2026.xlsx; redwood_pricing_tiers_summary.pdf

Thanks — talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Johnson <alex@acme.ai>

Date: 2026-04-08T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: post-call recap & numbers

Thanks Marissa — great recap and thanks for the attachments. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Monthly tokens: please budget for a range of 300M–350M tokens (we're comfortable saying 320M as a working number).
- Peak TPS: yes, plan for short bursts up to 30 TPS (we see spikes during peak business hours; steady-state is ~8 TPS).
- Budget: the $12k–$18k/mo range is in the right ballpark for a pilot, but procurement will want committed-unit pricing for production.
- Unit economics: we were hoping to target ~$30 / 1M tokens for committed pricing; can you show both the committed and on-demand tiers and the overage rates?

Procurement notes: procurement cycle starts mid-May, and they will want a sample invoice and an outline of overage mechanics. Also, is there a minimum SLA for hosted API (p95 latency target) tied to commit levels?

If you can send a formal 3-month pilot quote + a 12mo committed pricing scenario (with per-1M token numbers, expected monthly cost, and overage terms), that will help move procurement. Also add any details on peak TPS throttling and fallbacks (model variant routing) if capacity is constrained.

–Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Product, Acme AI
alex@acme.ai | (617) 555-0147
